CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MEETING AGENDA
April 3, 2024, 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard
-----------------------------------------------------------------
1.  Pledge of Allegiance.
2.  Roll Call.
3.  Communications from staff.
4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to
  address the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda
  other than a public hearing may do so at this time.
5.  Minute(s) approval for March 6, 2024, Planning Commission
  meeting(s).
6.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A public hearing to consider an application by Elliot
  Weinstock, representing 225 North La Brea, LLC, for Special
  Use Permit No. 2021-012 (SP-2021-012) to approve a Final
  Planned Assembly Development (PAD) to allow a 5-story
  multiple-family residential building that consists of 137
  studio apartment units with 69 surface parking spaces on
  an approximately 68,000 square-foot, MU-2 (Mixed Use-2)
  zoned property at 225 North La Brea Avenue.

  Planning Commission Actions:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Approve the final precise plans.
  2) Adopt the resolution approving SP-2021-012.

  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions and modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.

  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the
  request, or any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Deny the SUP and make the appropriate findings.
  Item 6a Documents

  b. A public hearing to consider an application by Erika Diaz
  representing Woods Diaz Group, LLC for Special Use Permit
  No. 23-00027 (SUP23-00027) to allow the sale of beer and
  wine for off-site consumption in an approximately 2,050
  square-foot one-story retail tenant space that is part of
  a multiple-tenant commercial building on an approximately
  26,600 square-foot, MU-C (TOD Mixed-Use Corridor) zoned
  property at 3535 West Imperial Highway.

  Planning Commission Actions:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the Public Convenience or Necessity finding.
  2) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2024-030.
  3) Adopt the attached resolution approving SUP23-00027.
   B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions and modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.

  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the
  request it is recommended to:
  1) Deny the Special Use Permit and make the appropriate
  findings.
  Item 6b Documents

  c. A public hearing to consider an application by Jennifer
  Weigand, representing KTGY, for Special Use Permit No. 23-
  00029 (SUP23-00029) to allow the construction of an
  approximately 3,700-square-foot fast-food restaurant with
  a drive-through and outdoor dining on an approximately
  34,000-square-foot,  C-2A/P-1  (Airport
  Commercial/Automobile Parking)zoned property at 11312
  South Prairie Avenue.

  Planning Commission Actions:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the Public Convenience or Necessity finding.
  2) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2024-032.
  3) Adopt the attached resolution approving SUP23-00029.

  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions and modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.

  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the
  request it is recommended to:
  1) Deny the Special Use Permit and make the appropriate
  findings.
  Item 6c Documents

7.  NON-PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A non-public hearing to consider an application by Shomof
  Hospitality, LLC One year review and assessment of SP-2020-
  004 approved on August 5, 2020, to allow 1) the on-site
  consumption of beer and wine and distilled spirits, 2)
  outdoor dining, and 3) outdoor live entertainment within a
  hotel, hotel restaurant, and hotel pool lounge on an
  approximately  86,102  square-foot,  M-1L  (Limited
  Manufacturing) zoned property at 3900 West Century
  Boulevard.

  Planning Commission Actions:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the approval of Resolution No. 1877 dated
  August 5, 2020.

  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions and modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.

  2
   C. If the Planning Commission determines to REVOKE the
  request it is recommended to:
  1) Revoke the Special Use Permit and make the
  appropriate findings.
  Item 7a Documents

8.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning
  Commission on any matter within their jurisdiction and not
  elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

9.  Commission Initiatives.

10.  Adjournment.
If you will require special accommodations, due to a disability,
please contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One
Manchester Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood,
CA 90301. All requests for special accommodations must be received
48 hours prior to the day of the hearing(s).
"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor
de llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."
In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of April 3, 2024,
is not held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other
agenda item being considered, the public hearing or non-public
hearing agenda item will automatically be continued to the next
regular Planning Commission meeting.

  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
  WEDNESDAY, MAY 1, 2024, 7:00 P.M.
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS, NINTH FLOOR, INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  ONE MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301
